MPCurve infers latent sample orderings and smooth feature trajectories from
multivariate data. This site presents selected results fitted by
coordinate-ascent variational inference (CAVI) in **MPCurver 0.3.0**.

## Method

MPCurve places samples on an ordered grid and estimates a smooth trajectory
for each feature. With multiple orderings, it also estimates which features
follow each ordering. The [method overview](method.html) explains the model
and algorithm; the [MPCurver package site](https://aguerozz.github.io/MPCurver/)
provides full vignettes and software documentation.

## Simulation

- [One ordering: a noisy spiral](simulation_m1.html) tests recovery of a known
  sample order.
- [Two orderings: two feature groups](simulation_m2.html) tests recovery of
  feature assignments and both sample orders.

## Analysis

- [Fitness across environments](fitness.html) compares mutant orderings and
  environment groups, including a fit that uses measurement uncertainty.
- [Pancreatic cell loadings](pancreas.html) compares one- and two-ordering fits
  on the same semi-NMF loading matrix.
